st: The Ghastly Steel Machine!
d: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have been weakened by Mukotsu's poison.

st: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango: Desperate Situation!
d: At the temple, Inuyasha checks to see of Kagome and the others are safe. He ends up trusting Renkotsu. Ginkotsu bombards him.

st: Inuyasha Shows His Tears For The First Time
d: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have stopped breathing. Inuyasha searches for the Band of Seven to avenge them.

st: The Secret of the Pure Light
d: Inuyasha and the gang approach the light of a Sacred Jewel which appears to belong to the Band of Seven, but the light is not corrupt.

st: Hidden in the Mist: Onward to Mt. Hakurei!
d: Suikotsu's Band of Seven personality awakens and fights Inuyasha. When the children call out to him to turn back, he holds his head in pain.

st: Enter Bankotsu, The Leader of the Band of Seven
d: There is a barrier around Mt. Hakurei that purifies demons or anything evil.

st: The Big Clash: Banryu versus the Wind Scar
d: The battle between Bankotsu and Inuyasha begins. Meanwhile, Sesshomatu comes to Mt. Hakurei.

st: Afloat on the Lake Surface: the Barrier of Hijiri Island
d: There is a holy island in a lake surrounded by mist. Saint Hakushin, who become a living Buddha a hundred years ago, is venerated there.

st: The Sacred Vajra and the Mystery of the Living Buddha
d: Bankotsu gets Kagome and the others involved in his battle with Inuyasha. Inuyasha is angered that his friends are getting hurt, and corners Bankotsu.

st: Koga's Solitary Battle
d: Mt. Hakurei's holy barrier prevents demons from entering it. Saint Hakushin helped Naraku, and placed the barrier.

st: Lured by the Black Light
d: Mt. Hakurei gets stronger, and Kikyo is prevented from going into its hold ground.

st: The Exposed Face of Truth
d: Suikotsu cannot kill Chiyo and the others. Jakotsu stops him. He senses an attack from Sesshomaru.

st: Vanished in a River of Flames
d: Ginkotsu has died, and Renkotsu uses his shard without permission. In doing so, he has betrayed Bankotsu. He cannot go back anymore.

st: Into the Depths of Mt. Hakurei
d: The evil within Mt. Hakurei is Naraku's demons and Kagura. Miroku risks his life to save Sango, by opening his Wind Tunnel and sucking in the demons.

st: Divine Malice of the Saint
d: Miroku and Sango come face to face with the Saint Hakushin's mummy on Mt. Hakurei. The saint tells them his reason for helping Naraku.

st: Fare Thee Well: Jakotsu's Requiem
d: Inuyasha regains his demon powers. He defeats Jakotsu, and hurries to Mt. Hakurei. Renkotsu has rebellious feelings towards Bankotsu.

st: Final Battle: The Last and Strongest of the Band of Seven
d: Mt. Hakurei's barrier disappears. Inuyasha is worried about Kagome. Kagome heads to Mt. Hakurei with Koga and the others.

st: The Power of Banryu: Duel to the Death on Mt. Hakurei
d: Miroku and Sango see a mysterious lump of flesh in the depths of Mt. Hakurei.

st: Beyond the Darkness - Naraku Reborn!
d: Naraku has gained a new body and has been reborn.

st: Farewell Kikyo, My Beloved
d: Mt. Hakurei is destroyed. Koga falls to the bottom of it. Inuyasha saves him.

st: The Darkness in Kagome's Heart
d: Inuyasha is pulled away from his friends when he is tricked by fake information that Kikyo is still alive.

st: Transform Heartache into Courage!
d: Naraku's baby carries Kagome to an abandoned temple. He orders Kagura to place a corrupt Sacred Jewel shard in her.

st: Don't Boil It! The Terrifying Dried-Up Demon!
d: In feudal Japan, Naraku has sent a demon called Mimisenri to look for the Sacred Jewel shards.

st: Chokyukai and the Abducted Bride
d: A demon named Chokyukai is revived, and begins to steal girls. A young man named Kisuke comes to Kaede for help. Inuyasha go to defeat the demon.

st: Shippo's New Technique, The Heart Scar!
d: Five demon fox brothers believe Shippo to be a hero. They become his disciples to learn his special technique, the Wind Scar.

st: Trap of The Cursed Wall Hanging
d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Shinosuke, who is looking for his fiancée. They are led to a village of only women, and are separated by sex into their rooms.

st: Miroku's Most Dangerous Confession
d: At a village where only women live, a demon that was sealed away in a hanging scroll at Kanondo is revived.

st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 1
d: Sara, a mysterious woman, appears before Sara. Sara was once saved by Sesshomaru. She was reincarnated just as she had died from an illness.

st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 2
d: Sara asks Sesshomaru to destroy her along with the spirit. Sesshomaru complies, and uses the Tessaiga to destroy Sara along with the spirit.

st: The Last Banquet of Miroku's Master
d: Priest Mushin, the person who raised Miroku, is going to die. Miroku and the others are shocked.

st: A Strange Invisible Demon Appears!
d: A treasure stealing invisible demon appears. An old lady who failed to defeat him asks Inuyasha and the gang for help.

st: An Ancestor Named Kagome
d: Akitoki, Hoji's ancestor is on a journey to offer the Hojo family heirloom, the Kenkon Naginata, a demon sword that brings disaster.
